description: This Dart source file defines the 'SavedNewsDb' class, which provides persistence for saved or bookmarked news articles using the 'sqflite' database package. It includes methods for initializing the database, saving/updating articles, deleting articles by headline, and retrieving all saved articles. The class also supports a fallback to in-memory storage for environments where 'sqflite' is unavailable, such as web or certain preview/test environments.

classes.name: SavedNewsDb
classes.description: Persistence layer for saved and bookmarked news articles, supporting both local database and in-memory fallback.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the database or switches to in-memory fallback if database setup fails.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Saves or updates an article in the database or in-memory store.

methods.name: deleteByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes an article by its headline from the database or in-memory store.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all saved articles, ordering them by recency.
